newsitem.title: ITALY: Bank of Italy says June PSDR up at 24.27 trln lire.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Italy says June PSDR up at 24.27 trln lire.

text.p: Italy's Public Sector Debt Repayment (PSDR) in June rose to 24.270 trillion lire from a surplus of 16.733 trillion in June 1995, according to Bank of Italy data in its regular bulletin on the economy released on Tuesday.

Latest Treasury figures, and not comparable with those of the central bank, showed a cumulative Public Sector Borrowing Requirement (PSBR) to end-May of 76.489 trillion lire compared with 66.439 trillion in the same 1995 period.
The Bank figures showed June revenue totalled 67.651 trillion lire, against 63.215 trillion in June 1995. Of that, 64.004 trillion was tax receipts, compared with 60.035 trillion in June 1995.
Total expenditure was 44.761 trillion lire, against 64.676 trillion in June 1995, of which 34.093 trillion lire was current spending against 59.499 trillion lire.

In the first half of 1996, PSBR totalled 52.185 trillion lire up from 49.756 trillion lire in the same period of 1995. The Bank of Italy did not detail the amount of treasury operations or other operations making up the PSBR total.
